criteria.requirement: Give a workable current-API plan with positive batch sizes, deliberate short-tail handling and error/commit policy. Separate bounded per-batch storage from growing deduplication state and external side effects; do not claim automatic rollback or end-to-end streaming from one helper.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
